articles.title: Hiroyuki Sanada in final talks to join live-action ‘Naruto’
articles.description: Hiroyuki Sanada is reportedly in negotiations to play Hiruzen Sarutobi in the upcoming live-action adaptation of 'Naruto'. Charles Melton is also in talks for the role of Kakashi Hatake, contributing to strong casting choices. Directed by Destin Daniel Cretton, the film involves the original manga creator Masashi Kishimoto. The story follows Naruto Uzumaki, a ninja aspiring to become the leader of his village.
